data.title: Base URL
data.tagline: An address prefix shared by a group of API requests, onto which specific endpoint paths are appended.
data.learningOutcome: You can find the Base URL in common Codex and Claude Code config files and check the model and request path after changing it.
data.description: For example, one client may combine `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` with `/chat/completions` to form the full request URL. Whether `/v1` belongs in the prefix and which path the client appends depend on both the service and the client. Check both sets of official documentation instead of applying one fixed pattern.

learning.assumes: You know that a web address usually has a domain and a path.
learning.outcome: You can find the Base URL in common Codex and Claude Code config files and check the model and request path after changing it.

distinctions.label: URL
distinctions.explanation: A URL is the complete locator for an internet resource; a Base URL is a common prefix string onto which endpoints and query parameters are appended.

explanation.title: Use a restaurant address to understand Base URL
explanation.text: Imagine the AI tool as someone placing an order for you. The Base URL is like the restaurant's address: it tells the tool where to send the request; it does not choose the model.

explanation.title: Where can you find the Base URL setting?
explanation.text: Codex: `~/.codex/config.toml`; Claude Code: global `~/.claude/settings.json`, project-level `.claude/settings.json`. If you use an environment variable, also check `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`.

explanation.title: A local service may use its own address
explanation.text: A local model may use `http://localhost:11434/v1`, which sends the request to your computer; it is not the same address as OpenRouter.

data.boundary: When troubleshooting a Base URL, check three things: the request address is correct, the service supports the model, and the API key came from that service.

lessonPractice.title: Which Base URL is suitable when configuring OpenRouter?

options.label: Use `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` and let the tool add the request path
options.feedback: Correct. For OpenAI-compatible services like OpenRouter, the path prefix /api/v1 is needed; however, not all providers use /v1 (e.g. Anthropic uses `https://api.anthropic.com`). Always check the provider's documentation.

options.label: Use the full `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions`
options.feedback: Incorrect. This includes the full endpoint path. The Base URL should only contain the shared prefix; otherwise, when the tool appends the endpoint path, it will result in a malformed URL.

options.label: Use only `https://openrouter.ai`
options.feedback: This leaves out the path required by the OpenRouter service, so it cannot replace the complete Base URL.

data.agentPrompt: Check whether this configuration should use `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` as the Base URL and confirm that the tool adds the request path afterward. Do not print a real key.
